name: Kazami Luka
source:
A talented singer-songwriter who gave up everything except singing.

He is a singer-songwriter making waves on the music charts under the name LUCA, a faceless artist. Although he has an androgynous and handsome appearance that catches many eyes, he speaks in a rough manner and has few interests outside of music.
